candidate_identity.broad_structure: Wealth-distribution and platform group with securities and fund-distribution activity; this is a selection premise, not a finding from a report.

selection_order.selection_rule: First qualifying fresh company cluster considered under the permitted pre-outcome inputs. No ordering used price, return, analyst, outcome, or prior-artifact attractiveness.

structure_mechanism_rationale.why_materially_testable: In a wealth-distribution/platform structure, a customer, assets, users, or activity carrier can plausibly be stated for a product, affiliate, company, or other responsibility perimeter while fee income, recurring profit, cash, or capital efficiency is stated for another perimeter. The V4 behavior is therefore capable of changing whether a composite conversion claim is granted, withheld, or kept local-only.
structure_mechanism_rationale.required_holdout_behavior: Name each reported perimeter before combining the activity and economic carriers; combine only identical perimeters or an issuer-provided explicit bridge. Otherwise retain the independent facts and localize the conversion proposition.
structure_mechanism_rationale.selection_basis_boundary: This rationale uses only the broad business-category premise and the V4 rule. It does not assert that any particular carrier, perimeter, bridge, or conversion result appears in the annual-report packet.

prior_curriculum_cluster_exclusion.freshness_result: COMPANY:CN300059 is absent from the reviewed curriculum company-cluster set.

cutoff.strict_publication_rule: Each admitted annual-report metadata record has an official publication date strictly before 2024-05-01.

official_packet_metadata.query_scope: CN300059 annual-report metadata, category_ndbg_szsh, publication dates 2021-01-01 through 2024-05-01; report bodies were not requested or opened.
official_packet_metadata.clean_packet_basis: The official index returned one full annual-report metadata record for each of FY2021, FY2022, and FY2023, all before the cutoff. Summaries were not admitted as packet reports.

permitted_selection_inputs: The frozen V4 method pack, including its scope-matched composite-metric behavior and paired-holdout contract.
Only the curriculum case identity, track, and company-cluster fields used to exclude previously seen clusters.
Candidate identifier, issuer name, and broad non-outcome business-category premise needed to test the V4 scope behavior.
Official CNINFO announcement metadata used only to confirm the clean FY2021-FY2023 pre-cutoff packet.
prohibitions_and_firewall: Do not open, download, parse, summarize, or infer from annual-report, announcement, or PDF bodies during selection.
Do not identify or read FY2024 outcome metadata or any post-cutoff announcement metadata or bodies.
Do not read campaign artifacts, historical reports, Method Pack V3, price data, return data, analyst data, or outcome material.
Do not use a browser or any selection signal tied to realized performance, valuation, subsequent events, or outcome attractiveness.
Baseline and Enhanced must later receive the same cutoff-bounded, result-unseen packet, tools, and stated budget.
